scene.my.cs = 1.25; scene.my.maxCells = 220; scene.my.maxWalk = 320; scene.my.maxFall = 240;
scene.my.found = false; scene.my.fi = 0; scene.my.oList = []; scene.my.oCount = 0;
scene.my.nCells = 0; scene.my.cells = []; scene.my.cBlockL = []; scene.my.cBlockR = []; scene.my.cRamp = []; scene.my.cHeat = [];
scene.my.heatCursor = 0; scene.my.curCellHeat = 0.0; scene.my.prevHeatCell = -1; scene.my.heatDwell = 0;
scene.my.kHeatCell = -1; scene.my.kHeatIdx = -1;
scene.my.kPrevGx = -9999; scene.my.kPrevGy = -9999; scene.my.kCachedCost = 99999; scene.my.kCachedHop = -1; scene.my.kCachedBfGen = -1;
scene.my.nWalk = 0; scene.my.wA = []; scene.my.wB = []; scene.my.wByK = []; scene.my.wFail = []; scene.my.wCool = []; scene.my.wUse = [];
scene.my.nFall = 0; scene.my.fA = []; scene.my.fB = []; scene.my.fX = []; scene.my.fVx = []; scene.my.fByK = []; scene.my.fFail = []; scene.my.fCool = []; scene.my.fUse = [];
scene.my.coolCount = 0;
scene.my.kAir = 0; scene.my.kGnd = 0; scene.my.kPeakAir = 0; scene.my.kLastK = -1; scene.my.kLastGX = 0; scene.my.kLastGVx = 0; scene.my.kRefK = -1; scene.my.kPvy = 0;
scene.my.vAir = 0; scene.my.vGnd = 0; scene.my.vPeakAir = 0; scene.my.vLastK = -1; scene.my.vLastGX = 0; scene.my.vLastGVx = 0; scene.my.vRefK = -1; scene.my.vPvy = 0;
scene.my.oAir = 0; scene.my.oGnd = 0; scene.my.oPeakAir = 0; scene.my.oLastK = -1; scene.my.oLastGX = 0; scene.my.oLastGVx = 0; scene.my.oRefK = -1;
scene.my.kGroundNx = 0.0; scene.my.kGroundNy = 1.0; scene.my.kGroundContactTick = -99;
scene.my.hitWallR = false; scene.my.hitWallL = false;
scene.my.vCells = []; scene.my.nVCells = 0;
scene.my.cCost = []; scene.my.cHop = []; scene.my.nCReady = 0;
scene.my.bfCost = []; scene.my.bfHop = []; scene.my.bfN = 0;
scene.my.bfCursor = 0; scene.my.bfPass = 0; scene.my.bfChanged = false; scene.my.bfGen = 0;
scene.my.bfDirty = true; scene.my.bfNeedsInit = true; scene.my.bfResweep = false; scene.my.prevTargetCell = -1;
scene.my.edgeAttemptTicks = 0; scene.my.activeHop = -1; scene.my.activeHopSrc = -1; scene.my.activeHopGoal = false; scene.my.lastUsedHop = -1;
scene.my.ppPrevA = -1; scene.my.ppPrevB = -1; scene.my.ppCount = 0; scene.my.lastDesiredVx = 0.0;
scene.my.microTimer = 0; scene.my.microStartX = 0.0; scene.my.microBackoff = 0; scene.my.microBackDir = 1.0;
scene.my.microSurge = 0; scene.my.microSurgeDir = 1.0; scene.my.microCell = -1; scene.my.microStallN = 0;
scene.my.famLoopTimer = 0; scene.my.famLoopAnchorX = 0.0; scene.my.famLoopAnchorY = 0.0; scene.my.famLastCells = 0;
scene.my.passiveBreakoutTimer = 0; scene.my.unstickTimer = 0; scene.my.unstickIdleTicks = 0; scene.my.unstickDir = 1.0;
scene.my.passiveStaleTicks = 0; scene.my.passiveLastCells = 0; scene.my.patrolTimer = 0; scene.my.patrolTargetK = -1; scene.my.patrolTargetX = 0.0; scene.my.patrolScore = -99999.0;
scene.my.modeLabel = "PASSIVE_EXPLORE";
scene.my.windupPhase = 0; scene.my.windupTicks = 0; scene.my.windupDir = 1.0;
scene.my.windupStartX = 0.0; scene.my.windupStartY = 0.0; scene.my.windupEdge = -1; scene.my.windupTriedCell = -1;
scene.my.hudHop = "NONE"; scene.my.hudMode = "NONE"; scene.my.hudCost = 99999; scene.my.hudUse = 0; scene.my.hudThought = "Exploring new territory -> rolling as natural marble";
scene.my.backoff = 0; scene.my.backDir = 1.0; scene.my.curHoleX = 99999; scene.my.stuckN = 0; scene.my.planIgnore = 0;
scene.my.holeDropTimer = 0; scene.my.suspectHoleX = 0.0; scene.my.hasSuspectHole = false; scene.my.alignTimer = 0;
scene.my.atLift = false; scene.my.liftDir = 0;
scene.my.tk = 0; scene.my.dump = ""; scene.my.ev0 = ""; scene.my.ev1 = ""; scene.my.ev2 = "";
scene.my.kState = "INIT"; scene.my.kCell = -1; scene.my.targetCell = -1; scene.my.hudText = "V0.9 INIT";
scene.my.hudTick = 6; scene.my.hudVer = 0;
scene.my.seekerPos = [0, 0]; scene.my.targetPos = [0, 0]; scene.my.targetVel = [0, 0];
scene.my.d0 = [9999, 9999]; scene.my.d1 = [9999, 9999]; scene.my.d2 = [9999, 9999]; scene.my.d3 = [9999, 9999];
scene.my.bestScore = 99999; scene.my.hasTarget = false;
scene.my.floorRefY = 0.0; scene.my.lastFloorY = 0.0; scene.my.airTicks = 0;
scene.my.blockedRight = false; scene.my.blockedLeft = false; scene.my.scanDir = 1.0;
scene.my.progressTimer = 0; scene.my.progressStartX = 0.0;
scene.my.aiV4Init = false;

scene.my.logEv = (c)=>{
    scene.my.ev2 = scene.my.ev1;
    scene.my.ev1 = scene.my.ev0;
    scene.my.ev0 = c + " @ " + scene.my.dump
};

scene.my.flr = (x)=>{
    _m := x % 1;
    (x < 0 && _m != 0) ? (x - _m - 1) : (x - _m)
};

scene.my.key = (px, py)=>{
    _gx := scene.my.flr(px / scene.my.cs) + 500;
    _gy := scene.my.flr(py / scene.my.cs) + 500;
    _gx * 1000 + _gy
};

scene.my.findCChunk = (k, lo, cnt)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        scene.my.cells(_i) == k ? { scene.my.found = true; scene.my.fi = _i } : {}
    })
};
scene.my.findCell = (k, n)=>{
    scene.my.found = false;
    scene.my.fi = -1;
    _rem := n % 20;
    _nc := (n - _rem) / 20;
    _nc > 0 ? {
        for(_nc, (c)=>{
            !scene.my.found ? { scene.my.findCChunk(k, c * 20, 20) } : {}
        })
    } : {};
    (!scene.my.found && _rem > 0) ? {
        scene.my.findCChunk(k, _nc * 20, _rem)
    } : {}
};

scene.my.setAtChunk = (lst, lo, cnt, idx, val)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        scene.my.oList = scene.my.oList ++ [(_i == idx) ? val : lst(_i)]
    })
};
scene.my.setAt = (lst, n, idx, val)=>{
    scene.my.oList = [];
    _rem := n % 20;
    _nc := (n - _rem) / 20;
    _nc > 0 ? {
        for(_nc, (c)=>{
            scene.my.setAtChunk(lst, c * 20, 20, idx, val)
        })
    } : {};
    _rem > 0 ? {
        scene.my.setAtChunk(lst, _nc * 20, _rem, idx, val)
    } : {}
};

scene.my.heatStep = (kCell, isGnd)=>{
    _n := scene.my.nCells;
    _n <= 0 ? {
        scene.my.curCellHeat = 0.0
    } : {
        _kIdx := -1;
        (kCell == scene.my.kHeatCell && scene.my.kHeatIdx >= 0 && scene.my.kHeatIdx < _n) ? {
            _kIdx = scene.my.kHeatIdx
        } : {
            scene.my.findCell(kCell, _n);
            _kIdx = scene.my.found ? scene.my.fi : -1;
            _kIdx != -1 ? {
                scene.my.kHeatCell = kCell;
                scene.my.kHeatIdx = _kIdx
            } : {}
        };
        _kIdx == -1 ? {
            scene.my.curCellHeat = 0.0
        } : {
            scene.my.curCellHeat = scene.my.cHeat(_kIdx);
            isGnd == 1 ? {
                _addAmt := 0.0;
                kCell != scene.my.prevHeatCell ? {
                    _addAmt = 6.0;
                    scene.my.prevHeatCell = kCell;
                    scene.my.heatDwell = 0
                } : {
                    scene.my.heatDwell = scene.my.heatDwell + 1;
                    scene.my.heatDwell >= 10 ? {
                        _addAmt = 3.0;
                        scene.my.heatDwell = 0
                    } : {}
                };
                _addAmt > 0.0 ? {
                    _nh := scene.my.curCellHeat + _addAmt;
                    _nh = (_nh > 200.0) ? 200.0 : _nh;
                    scene.my.setAt(scene.my.cHeat, _n, _kIdx, _nh);
                    scene.my.cHeat = scene.my.oList;
                    scene.my.curCellHeat = _nh
                } : {}
            } : {}
        };
        scene.my.tk % 4 == 0 ? {
            scene.my.heatCursor >= _n ? { scene.my.heatCursor = 0 } : {};
            _dh := scene.my.cHeat(scene.my.heatCursor);
            _dh > 0.0 ? {
                _ndh := (_dh > 0.08) ? (_dh - 0.08) : 0.0;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.cHeat, _n, scene.my.heatCursor, _ndh);
                scene.my.cHeat = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.heatCursor == _kIdx ? { scene.my.curCellHeat = _ndh } : {}
            } : {};
            scene.my.heatCursor = (scene.my.heatCursor + 1) % _n
        } : {}
    }
};

scene.my.coolChunk = (lst, lo, cnt, dec)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        _v := lst(_i) - dec;
        _nv := (_v > 0) ? _v : 0;
        _nv > 0 ? { scene.my.oCount = scene.my.oCount + 1 } : {};
        scene.my.oList = scene.my.oList ++ [_nv]
    })
};
scene.my.coolList = (lst, n, dec)=>{
    scene.my.oList = [];
    _rem := n % 20;
    _nc := (n - _rem) / 20;
    _nc > 0 ? {
        for(_nc, (c)=>{
            scene.my.coolChunk(lst, c * 20, 20, dec)
        })
    } : {};
    _rem > 0 ? {
        scene.my.coolChunk(lst, _nc * 20, _rem, dec)
    } : {}
};

scene.my.coolStep = (u)=>{
    (scene.my.coolCount > 0 && scene.my.tk % 15 == 0) ? {
        _prevCool := scene.my.coolCount;
        scene.my.oCount = 0;
        scene.my.nWalk > 0 ? {
            scene.my.coolList(scene.my.wCool, scene.my.nWalk, 15);
            scene.my.wCool = scene.my.oList
        } : {};
        scene.my.nFall > 0 ? {
            scene.my.coolList(scene.my.fCool, scene.my.nFall, 15);
            scene.my.fCool = scene.my.oList
        } : {};
        scene.my.coolCount = scene.my.oCount;
        scene.my.coolCount < _prevCool ? {
            scene.my.bfDirty = true;
            scene.my.bfResweep = true
        } : {}
    } : {}
};

scene.my.markBlock = (k, dir)=>{
    scene.my.findCell(k, scene.my.nCells);
    scene.my.found ? {
        _idx := scene.my.fi;
        dir > 0 ? {
            scene.my.cBlockR(_idx) == 0 ? {
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.cBlockR, scene.my.nCells, _idx, 1);
                scene.my.cBlockR = scene.my.oList
            } : {}
        } : {
            scene.my.cBlockL(_idx) == 0 ? {
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.cBlockL, scene.my.nCells, _idx, 1);
                scene.my.cBlockL = scene.my.oList
            } : {}
        }
    } : {}
};

scene.my.markRamp = (k)=>{
    scene.my.findCell(k, scene.my.nCells);
    scene.my.found ? {
        _idx := scene.my.fi;
        scene.my.cRamp(_idx) == 0 ? {
            scene.my.setAt(scene.my.cRamp, scene.my.nCells, _idx, 1);
            scene.my.cRamp = scene.my.oList
        } : {}
    } : {}
};

scene.my.pickUnstickDir = (k, curDir)=>{
    _gx := (k - k % 1000) / 1000;
    _gy := k % 1000;
    _bL := 0;
    _bR := 0;
    scene.my.findCell(k, scene.my.nCells);
    scene.my.found ? {
        _bL = scene.my.cBlockL(scene.my.fi);
        _bR = scene.my.cBlockR(scene.my.fi)
    } : {};
    _hL := 9999.0;
    _hR := 9999.0;
    _bL == 0 ? {
        scene.my.findCell((_gx - 1) * 1000 + _gy, scene.my.nCells);
        _hL = scene.my.found ? scene.my.cHeat(scene.my.fi) : -0.5
    } : {};
    _bR == 0 ? {
        scene.my.findCell((_gx + 1) * 1000 + _gy, scene.my.nCells);
        _hR = scene.my.found ? scene.my.cHeat(scene.my.fi) : -0.5
    } : {};
    _ret := -curDir;
    (_hL + 0.1) < _hR ? {
        _ret = -1.0
    } : {
        (_hR + 0.1) < _hL ? {
            _ret = 1.0
        } : {}
    };
    _ret
};

scene.my.pickPatrolChunk = (lo, cnt)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        _ck := scene.my.cells(_i);
        _gy := _ck % 1000;
        _h := scene.my.cHeat(_i);
        _sc := (_gy * 2.5) - _h - ((_ck == scene.my.kCell) ? 5.0 : 0.0);
        _sc > scene.my.patrolScore ? {
            scene.my.patrolScore = _sc;
            scene.my.patrolTargetK = _ck
        } : {}
    })
};
scene.my.pickPatrolTarget = (u)=>{
    scene.my.patrolScore = -99999.0;
    scene.my.patrolTargetK = scene.my.kCell;
    _n := scene.my.nCells;
    _n > 0 ? {
        _rem := _n % 20;
        _nc := (_n - _rem) / 20;
        _nc > 0 ? {
            for(_nc, (c)=>{
                scene.my.pickPatrolChunk(c * 20, 20)
            })
        } : {};
        _rem > 0 ? {
            scene.my.pickPatrolChunk(_nc * 20, _rem)
        } : {};
        _gx := (scene.my.patrolTargetK - scene.my.patrolTargetK % 1000) / 1000 - 500;
        scene.my.patrolTargetX = (_gx + 0.5) * scene.my.cs
    } : {
        scene.my.patrolTargetX = scene.my.seekerPos(0) + scene.my.scanDir * 5.0
    }
};

scene.my.incUse = (hop)=>{
    hop >= 0 ? {
        hop < 1000 ? {
            hop < scene.my.nWalk ? {
                _nu := scene.my.wUse(hop) + 1;
                _nu = (_nu > 10) ? 10 : _nu;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.wUse, scene.my.nWalk, hop, _nu);
                scene.my.wUse = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                scene.my.bfResweep = true
            } : {}
        } : {
            _fi := hop - 1000;
            _fi < scene.my.nFall ? {
                _nu := scene.my.fUse(_fi) + 1;
                _nu = (_nu > 10) ? 10 : _nu;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.fUse, scene.my.nFall, _fi, _nu);
                scene.my.fUse = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                scene.my.bfResweep = true
            } : {}
        }
    } : {}
};

scene.my.getUse = (hop)=>{
    _res := 0;
    (hop >= 0 && hop < 1000) ? {
        hop < scene.my.nWalk ? {
            _res = scene.my.wUse(hop)
        } : {}
    } : {
        hop >= 1000 ? {
            _fi := hop - 1000;
            (_fi >= 0 && _fi < scene.my.nFall) ? {
                _res = scene.my.fUse(_fi)
            } : {}
        } : {}
    };
    _res
};

scene.my.hopCool = (hop)=>{
    _res := 999;
    (hop >= 0 && hop < 1000) ? {
        hop < scene.my.nWalk ? {
            _res = scene.my.wCool(hop)
        } : {}
    } : {
        hop >= 1000 ? {
            _fi := hop - 1000;
            (_fi >= 0 && _fi < scene.my.nFall) ? {
                _res = scene.my.fCool(_fi)
            } : {}
        } : {}
    };
    _res
};

scene.my.incFail = (hop)=>{
    hop >= 0 ? {
        hop < 1000 ? {
            hop < scene.my.nWalk ? {
                _nf := scene.my.wFail(hop) + 1;
                _nf = (_nf > 10) ? 10 : _nf;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.wFail, scene.my.nWalk, hop, _nf);
                scene.my.wFail = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.wCool, scene.my.nWalk, hop, 600);
                scene.my.wCool = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.coolCount = scene.my.coolCount + 1;
                scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                scene.my.bfResweep = true
            } : {}
        } : {
            _fi := hop - 1000;
            _fi < scene.my.nFall ? {
                _nf := scene.my.fFail(_fi) + 1;
                _nf = (_nf > 10) ? 10 : _nf;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.fFail, scene.my.nFall, _fi, _nf);
                scene.my.fFail = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.fCool, scene.my.nFall, _fi, 600);
                scene.my.fCool = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.coolCount = scene.my.coolCount + 1;
                scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                scene.my.bfResweep = true
            } : {}
        }
    } : {}
};

scene.my.hasWChunk = (a, b, lo, cnt)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        (scene.my.wA(_i) == a && scene.my.wB(_i) == b) ? { scene.my.found = true; scene.my.fi = _i } : {}
    })
};
scene.my.hasW = (a, b, i)=>{
    scene.my.found = false;
    _n := i + 1;
    _n > 0 ? {
        _rem := _n % 20;
        _nc := (_n - _rem) / 20;
        _nc > 0 ? {
            for(_nc, (c)=>{
                !scene.my.found ? { scene.my.hasWChunk(a, b, c * 20, 20) } : {}
            })
        } : {};
        (!scene.my.found && _rem > 0) ? {
            scene.my.hasWChunk(a, b, _nc * 20, _rem)
        } : {}
    } : {}
};

scene.my.hasFChunk = (a, x, vx, lo, cnt)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        _dx := scene.my.fX(_i) - x;
        _dvx := scene.my.fVx(_i) - vx;
        (scene.my.fA(_i) == a && _dx < 0.5 && _dx > -0.5 && _dvx < 1.0 && _dvx > -1.0) ? { scene.my.found = true; scene.my.fi = _i } : {}
    })
};
scene.my.hasF = (a, x, vx, i)=>{
    scene.my.found = false;
    _n := i + 1;
    _n > 0 ? {
        _rem := _n % 20;
        _nc := (_n - _rem) / 20;
        _nc > 0 ? {
            for(_nc, (c)=>{
                !scene.my.found ? { scene.my.hasFChunk(a, x, vx, c * 20, 20) } : {}
            })
        } : {};
        (!scene.my.found && _rem > 0) ? {
            scene.my.hasFChunk(a, x, vx, _nc * 20, _rem)
        } : {}
    } : {}
};

scene.my.ensureCell = (k)=>{
    scene.my.findCell(k, scene.my.nCells);
    (!scene.my.found && scene.my.nCells < scene.my.maxCells) ? {
        scene.my.cells = scene.my.cells ++ [k];
        scene.my.cBlockL = scene.my.cBlockL ++ [0];
        scene.my.cBlockR = scene.my.cBlockR ++ [0];
        scene.my.cRamp = scene.my.cRamp ++ [0];
        scene.my.cHeat = scene.my.cHeat ++ [0.0];
        scene.my.nCells = scene.my.nCells + 1;
        scene.my.bfDirty = true;
        scene.my.bfResweep = true
    } : {}
};

scene.my.recTick = (px, py, vx, vy, pvy, air, gnd, peakAir, lastK, lastGX, lastGVx, refK, isK, slopeHit)=>{
    _fall := ((vy - pvy) < -0.1) && (slopeHit == 0);
    scene.my.oAir = _fall ? (air + 1) : 0;
    scene.my.oGnd = _fall ? 0 : (gnd + 1);
    scene.my.oPeakAir = _fall ? ((scene.my.oAir > peakAir) ? scene.my.oAir : peakAir) : peakAir;
    scene.my.oLastK = lastK;
    scene.my.oLastGX = lastGX;
    scene.my.oLastGVx = lastGVx;
    scene.my.oRefK = refK;
    _minGnd := (isK == 0) ? 1 : 3;
    (_fall || scene.my.oGnd < _minGnd) ? {} : {
        _k := scene.my.key(px, py);
        scene.my.ensureCell(_k);
        (isK == 1 && slopeHit == 1) ? {
            _anx := (scene.my.kGroundNx < 0) ? -scene.my.kGroundNx : scene.my.kGroundNx;
            _anx > 0.20 ? { scene.my.markRamp(_k) } : {}
        } : {};
        refK == -1 ? { scene.my.oRefK = _k } : {};
        peakAir >= 3 ? {
            (lastK != -1 && _k != lastK) ? {
                scene.my.found = false;
                scene.my.hasF(lastK, lastGX, lastGVx, scene.my.nFall - 1);
                (!scene.my.found && scene.my.nFall < scene.my.maxFall) ? {
                    scene.my.fA = scene.my.fA ++ [lastK];
                    scene.my.fB = scene.my.fB ++ [_k];
                    scene.my.fX = scene.my.fX ++ [lastGX];
                    scene.my.fVx = scene.my.fVx ++ [lastGVx];
                    scene.my.fByK = scene.my.fByK ++ [isK];
                    scene.my.fFail = scene.my.fFail ++ [0];
                    scene.my.fCool = scene.my.fCool ++ [0];
                    scene.my.fUse = scene.my.fUse ++ [isK];
                    scene.my.nFall = scene.my.nFall + 1;
                    scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                    scene.my.bfResweep = true
                } : {
                    (scene.my.found && isK == 1) ? {
                        _hid := 1000 + scene.my.fi;
                        scene.my.fByK(scene.my.fi) == 0 ? {
                            scene.my.setAt(scene.my.fByK, scene.my.nFall, scene.my.fi, 1);
                            scene.my.fByK = scene.my.oList
                        } : {};
                        _hid != scene.my.lastUsedHop ? {
                            scene.my.incUse(_hid)
                        } : {
                            scene.my.lastUsedHop = -1
                        }
                    } : {}
                }
            } : {};
            scene.my.oPeakAir = 0;
            scene.my.oRefK = _k
        } : {
            (refK != -1 && _k != refK) ? {
                scene.my.found = false;
                scene.my.hasW(refK, _k, scene.my.nWalk - 1);
                (!scene.my.found && scene.my.nWalk < scene.my.maxWalk) ? {
                    scene.my.wA = scene.my.wA ++ [refK];
                    scene.my.wB = scene.my.wB ++ [_k];
                    scene.my.wByK = scene.my.wByK ++ [isK];
                    scene.my.wFail = scene.my.wFail ++ [0];
                    scene.my.wCool = scene.my.wCool ++ [0];
                    scene.my.wUse = scene.my.wUse ++ [isK];
                    scene.my.nWalk = scene.my.nWalk + 1;
                    scene.my.bfDirty = true;
                    scene.my.bfResweep = true
                } : {
                    (scene.my.found && isK == 1) ? {
                        _hid := scene.my.fi;
                        scene.my.wByK(scene.my.fi) == 0 ? {
                            scene.my.setAt(scene.my.wByK, scene.my.nWalk, scene.my.fi, 1);
                            scene.my.wByK = scene.my.oList
                        } : {};
                        _hid != scene.my.lastUsedHop ? {
                            scene.my.incUse(_hid)
                        } : {
                            scene.my.lastUsedHop = -1
                        }
                    } : {}
                };
                scene.my.oRefK = _k
            } : {}
        };
        scene.my.oLastK = _k;
        scene.my.oLastGX = px;
        scene.my.oLastGVx = vx
    }
};

scene.my.isVCell4 = (k, i)=>{
    i < 0 ? {} : {
        scene.my.vCells(i) == k ? { scene.my.found = true } : { scene.my.isVCell4(k, i - 1) }
    }
};

scene.my.addVCell = (k)=>{
    (k != -1 && scene.my.nVCells < 20) ? {
        scene.my.found = false;
        scene.my.nVCells > 0 ? {
            scene.my.isVCell4(k, scene.my.nVCells - 1)
        } : {};
        !scene.my.found ? {
            scene.my.vCells = scene.my.vCells ++ [k];
            scene.my.nVCells = scene.my.nVCells + 1
        } : {}
    } : {}
};

scene.my.bfSeedChunk = (lo, cnt)=>{
    for(cnt, (j)=>{
        _i := lo + j;
        _ck := scene.my.cells(_i);
        scene.my.found = false;
        scene.my.nVCells > 0 ? {
            scene.my.isVCell4(_ck, scene.my.nVCells - 1)
        } : {
            (scene.my.targetCell != -1 && _ck == scene.my.targetCell) ? { scene.my.found = true } : {}
        };
        scene.my.bfCost = scene.my.bfCost ++ [scene.my.found ? 0.0 : 99999];
        scene.my.bfHop = scene.my.bfHop ++ [-1]
    })
};

scene.my.bfInit = (u)=>{
    scene.my.bfCost = [];
    scene.my.bfHop = [];
    scene.my.bfN = scene.my.nCells;
    scene.my.bfCursor = 0;
    scene.my.bfPass = 0;
    scene.my.bfChanged = false;
    scene.my.bfNeedsInit = false;
    scene.my.bfResweep = false;
    _n := scene.my.bfN;
    _rem := _n % 20;
    _nc := (_n - _rem) / 20;
    _nc > 0 ? {
        for(_nc, (c)=>{
            scene.my.bfSeedChunk(c * 20, 20)
        })
    } : {};
    _rem > 0 ? {
        scene.my.bfSeedChunk(_nc * 20, _rem)
    } : {}
};

scene.my.bfRelax = (ei)=>{
    _isWalk := (ei >= 0 && ei < scene.my.nWalk);
    _fi := ei - scene.my.nWalk;
    _cool := 999;
    _u := 0;
    _v := 0;
    _byK := 1;
    _fail := 0;
    _use := 0;
    _isWalk ? {
        _cool = scene.my.wCool(ei);
        _u = scene.my.wA(ei);
        _v = scene.my.wB(ei);
        _byK = scene.my.wByK(ei);
        _fail = scene.my.wFail(ei);
        _use = scene.my.wUse(ei)
    } : {
        (_fi >= 0 && _fi < scene.my.nFall) ? {
            _cool = scene.my.fCool(_fi);
            _u = scene.my.fA(_fi);
            _v = scene.my.fB(_fi);
            _byK = scene.my.fByK(_fi);
            _fail = scene.my.fFail(_fi);
            _use = scene.my.fUse(_fi)
        } : {}
    };
    _cool > 0 ? {} : {
        _base := _isWalk ? 1.0 : ((_v % 1000 > _u % 1000) ? 2.0 : 1.2);
        _hop := _isWalk ? ei : (1000 + _fi);
        scene.my.findCell(_v, scene.my.bfN);
        _vFound := scene.my.found;
        _vIdx := scene.my.fi;
        scene.my.findCell(_u, scene.my.bfN);
        _uFound := scene.my.found;
        _uIdx := scene.my.fi;
        (_vFound && _uFound) ? {
            _heatPen := scene.my.cHeat(_vIdx) * 0.85;
            _usePen := _use * 14.0;
            _w := _base * ((_byK == 1) ? 1.0 : 1.25) * (1.0 + _fail * 1.5) + _heatPen + _usePen;
            _cand := scene.my.bfCost(_vIdx) + _w;
            _cand < scene.my.bfCost(_uIdx) ? {
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.bfCost, scene.my.bfN, _uIdx, _cand);
                scene.my.bfCost = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.setAt(scene.my.bfHop, scene.my.bfN, _uIdx, _hop);
                scene.my.bfHop = scene.my.oList;
                scene.my.bfChanged = true
            } : {}
        } : {}
    }
};

scene.my.bfStep = (u)=>{
    scene.my.bfDirty ? {
        _tot := scene.my.nWalk + scene.my.nFall;
        ((scene.my.bfNeedsInit || scene.my.bfN == 0) && scene.my.nCells > 0) ? {
            scene.my.bfInit(0)
        } : {};
        _tot == 0 ? {
            scene.my.bfN > 0 ? {
                scene.my.cCost = scene.my.bfCost;
                scene.my.cHop = scene.my.bfHop;
                scene.my.nCReady = scene.my.bfN;
                scene.my.bfGen = scene.my.bfGen + 1;
                scene.my.bfNeedsInit = true;
                scene.my.bfDirty = scene.my.bfResweep
            } : {}
        } : {
            _rem := _tot - scene.my.bfCursor;
            _steps := (_rem > 12) ? 12 : ((_rem > 0) ? _rem : 0);
            _s0 := (_steps > 6) ? 6 : _steps;
            _s1 := _steps - _s0;
            _s0 > 0 ? {
                for(_s0, (s)=>{
                    scene.my.bfRelax(scene.my.bfCursor);
                    scene.my.bfCursor = scene.my.bfCursor + 1
                })
            } : {};
            _s1 > 0 ? {
                for(_s1, (s)=>{
                    scene.my.bfRelax(scene.my.bfCursor);
                    scene.my.bfCursor = scene.my.bfCursor + 1
                })
            } : {};
            scene.my.bfCursor >= _tot ? {
                scene.my.bfCursor = 0;
                scene.my.bfPass = scene.my.bfPass + 1;
                (!scene.my.bfChanged || scene.my.bfPass >= 8) ? {
                    scene.my.cCost = scene.my.bfCost;
                    scene.my.cHop = scene.my.bfHop;
                    scene.my.nCReady = scene.my.bfN;
                    scene.my.bfGen = scene.my.bfGen + 1;
                    scene.my.bfNeedsInit = true;
                    scene.my.bfDirty = scene.my.bfResweep
                } : {
                    scene.my.bfChanged = false
                }
            } : {}
        }
    } : {}
};

scene.my.v09Setup = true
